_doc: Phase G.12 (Growth) — north-star KPI registry. /admin/kpis/ reads this file and renders 5 tiles with live Plausible queries + targets + trend arrows. scripts/check-kpi-doc.mjs asserts _lastReviewed is ≤90 days old; fails CI past that to force a quarterly re-look. Targets are aspirational, not promises — adjust them as data comes in.

kpis.label_es: Sesiones de búsqueda orgánica por semana
kpis.what_it_measures: Top-of-funnel demand from Google + Bing + DuckDuckGo (excludes AI-search referrers, which get their own metric).

kpis.metric: ratio: Tool First Result ÷ pageview on /tools/*
kpis.what_it_measures: Of visitors who land on a tool page, the share that actually run the tool. Bottom-of-page bounce vs. activation.

kpis.label_es: Tasa de guardado en el Taller
kpis.metric: ratio: Workbench Save ÷ Tool First Result
kpis.what_it_measures: Of visitors who run a tool, the share that save the result to their Workshop. The first commitment moment.

kpis.label_es: Tasa de participación en La Ventana
kpis.metric: ratio: distinct visitors with Window Sent ÷ distinct authenticated
kpis.what_it_measures: Share of signed-in operators who actually write to Don. Bottom-of-funnel intent.

kpis.plausible_filter: event:goal=Window Thread Resolved + props.outcome IN (call, contract)
kpis.what_it_measures: Of Window threads that get an outcome stamp, the share that escalate to a call or signed contract.
